q1: SELECT beer, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_gap, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves WHERE beer IN (SELECT s.beer FROM serves AS s, frequents AS f WHERE s.bar = f.bar AND f.drinker LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY s.beer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.bar) >= 2) GROUP BY beer ORDER BY beer
q2: WITH beer_bars AS (SELECT s.beer, s.price FROM serves AS s WHERE s.bar IN (SELECT f.bar FROM frequents AS f JOIN drinker AS d ON f.drinker = d.name WHERE d.name LIKE 'B%')) SELECT bb.beer, MAX(bb.price) - MIN(bb.price) AS price_gap, AVG(bb.price) AS avg_price FROM beer_bars AS bb GROUP BY bb.beer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT bb.price) >= 2 ORDER BY bb.beer
